sourceReferences.use: Flutter BASE form, ONLY LOWER RIGHT: cream fuzzy MOTH with four rounded lilac/blush petal wings, rounded antennae, huge VIOLET eyes, pink short cape with gold clasp, tiny folded letter. Keep moth wings and original face, never bunny ears. Signature: holds letter close then opens wings to release a small compact bell-like golden resonance ring, then settles.

processing: Imagegen background-cleanup edit; original generation and edited source preserved. Public PNG copied byte-for-byte from edited source, no programmatic pixel edits. Runtime frame rectangles/ground anchors measured separately.
technicalInspection: Desktop all20 poses and phone four groups all20 poses inspected; recognizable original species/costume, intact ears/tails/wings, no source-frame clipping or detached opaque haze observed. Foot anchors visually coherent for minimal two-stride cycle. Ambient butterflies are world decorations, not atlas artifacts.
limitations: Directional idle is one still per heading, not a breathing/blink cycle.
Two-stride walking is a minimal cycle; frame interpolation and four/eight-stride refinement remain review questions.
